No, unfortunately we cannot help you recover your password.

settingsCreateAccount2.faq5Answer.en:
Technically a Local Account offers stronger privacy guarantees. However, with a well-chosen password the difference is academic.

And a Local Account does not help ensure your own access to the data in case of device loss or in an emergency situation.

Ultimately it depends on what you are trying to achieve.

就技術而言，本機帳戶提供更強的隱私保障。但只要選擇了好密碼，這種差異實際上無關緊要。

而且本機帳戶在裝置遺失或緊急情況下，無法保證您能存取自己的資料。

最終取決於您想達成什麼目的。
settingsCreateAccount2.faq5Answer.zh-hant_en:
Technically speaking, a local-machine account provides stronger privacy guarantees. But as long as a good password is chosen, this difference is practically irrelevant.

Moreover, a local-machine account cannot guarantee that you can access your own data if the device is lost or in an emergency situation.

Ultimately it depends on what goal you want to achieve.

subCustomerData.whyAskInfo.en:
We need your country of residence to manage VAT (this has no impact on the price you pay - the price you are shown is the final price).

We will use your email address solely to send you receipts, notifications of failed payments, and reminders prior to renewal. Your email address also serves as a last resort for canceling your subscription in case you lose access to your account.

We will never use your email address for marketing purposes, newsletters, or any other kind of unsolicited communication.

The above data is shared with our payment provider to process your payment, primarily for fraud prevention.

We will, however, never share your data with any other parties. See our Privacy Policy for details.

All data is handled in compliance with both GDPR and Swiss data protection laws, regardless of your country of residence.

我們需要您的居住國家來處理增值稅（這不會影響您支付的價格——您看到的價格即為最終價格）。

我們只會使用您的電子郵件地址來傳送收據、付款失敗通知以及續訂前的提醒。您的電子郵件地址也是在您失去帳戶存取權時取消訂閱的最後手段。

我們絕不會將您的電子郵件地址用於行銷、電子報或任何未經請求的通訊。

上述資料會與我們的付款服務供應商共享以處理您的付款，主要用於防止詐欺。

但我們絕不會將您的資料與任何其他第三方共享。詳情請參閱我們的隱私權政策。

無論您居住在哪個國家，所有資料均依據 GDPR 及瑞士資料保護法處理。
subCustomerData.whyAskInfo.zh-hant_en:
We need your country of residence to handle value-added tax (this will not affect the price you pay——the price you see is the final price).

We will only use your email address to send receipts, payment-failure notifications, and reminders before renewal. Your email address is also the last resort for cancelling your subscription when you lose access to your account.

We will absolutely never use your email address for marketing, e-newsletters, or any unsolicited communication.

The above data is shared with our payment service provider to process your payment, mainly used to prevent fraud.

But we will absolutely never share your data with any other third party. For details please refer to our privacy rights policy.

No matter which country you live in, all data is handled in accordance with GDPR and Swiss data protection law.
